creator: Alexander Terp
description:
RosterPane carries only label, which holds the directory and harness for a pane nobody named and the given name for one somebody did. So a renamed pane's directory never reaches the shell, and frost's row ("Muster UI redesign") cannot say it runs in ~/src/muster.

Direction A's rows and the pane headers show every pane's directory (Lectern page muster-ui-redesign). The daemon knows each pane's directory: `muster window` lists them per machine. A field beside label keeps the label rule as it is.

## Plan (reviewed 2026-11-08)

From the plan for the redesign, step 1; the parent card a_2wKW8eBfM has its overall shape, order and checks.

The core already holds each pane's full cwd (`Pane.cwd`, `crates/muster-core/src/mirror/backend.rs`,
from the daemon's `Pane` record) and republishes the roster when it changes. Only the last path
component reaches the shell, folded into `beside_callsign`, and only for a pane nobody named.

- Add `string directory = 19` to `RosterPane` in `proto/muster.proto`: the full path as the daemon
  reports it, on every pane.
- Set it in both roster builders in `crates/muster-core/src/roster.rs` (tabs and hidden tabs) and in
  `crates/muster-seam/src/convert.rs`.
- The conformance driver (`crates/muster-core/tests/core/roster.rs`, `describe_pane`) prints it only
  when a case asks, so existing `corpus/conformance/roster.json` expectations stay as they are; add
  cases for a named pane carrying its directory and for a directory change.
- Swift mirrors it on `Roster.Pane`. The shell shortens it for display (last component, `~` for the
  home directory in the hover text); shortening is presentation, so it stays in `SidebarModel`.
title: The roster carries each pane's directory, so a named pane's row can show it
